an1.11:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno vā kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave subhanimittaṃ
an1.11:1.2: subhanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.12:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā byāpādo uppajjati uppanno vā byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave paṭighanimittaṃ
an1.12:1.2: paṭighanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikaroto anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.13:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave arati tandi vijambhikā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ
an1.13:1.2: līnacittassa bhikkhave anuppannañceva thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannañca thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.14:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cetaso avūpasamo
an1.14:1.2: avūpasantacittassa bhikkhave anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.15:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā uppajjati uppannā vā vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikāro
an1.15:1.2: ayoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.16:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando nuppajjati uppanno vā kāmacchando pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave asubhanimittaṃ
an1.16:1.2: asubhanimittaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando nuppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyatīti.
an1.17:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā byāpādo nuppajjati uppanno vā byāpādo pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave mettā cetovimutti
an1.17:1.2: mettaṃ bhikkhave cetovimuttiṃ yoniso manasikaroto anuppanno ceva byāpādo nuppajjati uppanno ca byāpādo pahīyatīti.
an1.18:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ nuppajjati uppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu
an1.18:1.2: āraddhaviriyassa bhikkhave anuppannañceva thīnamiddhaṃ nuppajjati uppannañca thīnamiddhaṃ pahīyatīti.
an1.19:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nuppajjati uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cetaso vūpasamo
an1.19:1.2: vūpasantacittassa bhikkhave anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nuppajjati uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyatīti.
an1.20:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā nuppajjati uppannā vā vicikicchā pahīyati yathayidaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikāro
an1.20:1.2: yoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā ceva vicikicchā nuppajjati uppannā ca vicikicchā pahīyatīti.
